```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Hmsc)
library(DHARMa)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Residual diagnostics for the two retained models

DHARMa whole-model residual analysis for the two models kept in the manuscript:

- **Abundance (Gaussian):** best WAIC model
- **Occurrence (Probit):** second-best WAIC model (selected because it showed
  better cross-validated AUC than the best WAIC model, see
  `7_cross_validation_best_models.Rmd`).

Each diagnostic panel (QQ + residuals-vs-predicted) is saved to
`figures/figures_manuscript/`. Uniformity, dispersion, outlier, and spatial
autocorrelation tests are also printed to the console.

```{r load-retained-models}
load("outputs/models/list_mods_genus_gauss_phylo_autocorr.RData")
load("outputs/models/list_mods_bin_phylo_autocorr_genus.RData")

load("outputs/models/WAIC_gauss_mod.txt")        # saved via save()
WAIC_bin_mod <- read.table("outputs/models/WAIC_bin_mod.txt")

best_gauss_name <- WAIC_gauss_mod %>%
  arrange(WAIC_vecor) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(model_names)

best_bin_name <- WAIC_bin_mod %>%
  arrange(WAIC_vecor_bin) %>% slice(2) %>% pull(model_names_bin)

cat("Retained Gaussian model (best WAIC):", best_gauss_name, "\n")
cat("Retained Probit model (2nd-best WAIC):", best_bin_name, "\n")

m_gauss_retained <- list_mods[[best_gauss_name]]$m_converg
m_bin_retained   <- list_mods_bin[[best_bin_name]]$m_converg
```

## Abundance (Gaussian) — best WAIC

`predict()` returns a list of length `nChains * nSamples`. Each element is an
`[n_sites x n_species]` matrix of posterior predictive draws. We reshape this
per species into an `[n_sites x n_samples]` simulation matrix for DHARMa.

```{r residuals-gauss-retained, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
Y_gauss  <- m_gauss_retained$Y
xy_gauss <- m_gauss_retained$XData[, c("lon", "lat")]

preds_gauss <- stats::predict(m_gauss_retained,
                              XData= m_gauss_retained$XData,
                              predictEtaMean = TRUE,
                              expected       = TRUE)

n_species_gauss <- ncol(preds_gauss[[1]])
n_sites_gauss   <- nrow(preds_gauss[[1]])
n_samples_gauss <- length(preds_gauss)

# Stack list -> 3D array [n_sites x n_species x n_samples]
preds_arr_gauss <- array(unlist(preds_gauss),
                         dim = c(n_sites_gauss, n_species_gauss, n_samples_gauss))

sim_list_gauss <- vector("list", n_samples_gauss)

library(matrixStats)

colnames(Y_gauss) == colnames(preds_gauss[[1]])
for (j in 1:n_samples_gauss) {
  sim_j <- preds_gauss[[j]]          # [n_sites x n_samples]
  sim_j[is.na(Y_gauss)] <- NA
  sim_j <- na.omit(as.vector(sim_j))
  sim_list_gauss[[j]] <- sim_j
}

sim_unlist_gauss <- array(unlist(sim_list_gauss), c(dim(sim_list_gauss[[1]]), length(sim_list_gauss)))
mod_gauss <- rowMedians(do.call(cbind, sim_list_gauss), na.rm = T)

str(do.call(cbind, sim_list_gauss))
str(na.omit(as.vector(Y_gauss)))
str(mod_gauss)

dharma_gauss <- createDHARMa(
  simulatedResponse       = do.call(cbind, sim_list_gauss),
  observedResponse        = na.omit(as.vector(Y_gauss)),
  fittedPredictedResponse = mod_gauss,
  integerResponse         = FALSE,
    
)

pdf("figures/figures_manuscript/residuals_dharma_gauss_best_waic.pdf",
    width = 10, height = 5)
plot(dharma_gauss, main = "DHARMa residuals -- Abundance (Gaussian):")
dev.off()

plot(dharma_gauss, main = "DHARMa residuals -- Abundance (Gaussian):")

cat("\n--- Uniformity ---\n");  print(testUniformity(dharma_gauss))
cat("\n--- Dispersion ---\n");  print(testDispersion(dharma_gauss))
cat("\n--- Outliers ---\n");    print(testOutliers(dharma_gauss))

# Stack xy once per species to match the column-major order of as.vector(Y_gauss),
# then drop the same NA positions that na.omit() dropped from observed/simulated.
xy_all_gauss      <- xy_gauss[rep(seq_len(n_sites_gauss), times = n_species_gauss), ]
xy_all_gauss      <- xy_all_gauss[!is.na(as.vector(Y_gauss)), , drop = FALSE]
coord_key_gauss   <- paste(xy_all_gauss[, "lon"], xy_all_gauss[, "lat"], sep = "_")
coord_fac_gauss   <- factor(coord_key_gauss)
dharma_site_gauss <- recalculateResiduals(dharma_gauss, group = coord_fac_gauss)
xy_unique_gauss   <- xy_all_gauss[match(levels(coord_fac_gauss), coord_key_gauss), ]

cat("\n--- Spatial autocorrelation ---\n")
pdf("figures/figures_manuscript/spatial_autocorr_dharma_gauss_second_best_waic.pdf",
    width = 10, height = 5)
print(testSpatialAutocorrelation(dharma_site_gauss,
                                 x = xy_unique_gauss[, "lon"],
                                 y = xy_unique_gauss[, "lat"]))
dev.off()
```
	DHARMa Moran's I test for distance-based autocorrelation

data:  dharma_site_gauss
observed = -0.080486, expected = -0.011494, sd = 0.080821, p-value = 0.3933
alternative hypothesis: Distance-based autocorrelation

## Occurrence (Probit) — second-best WAIC

```{r residuals-bin-retained, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
Y_bin  <- m_bin_retained$Y
xy_bin <- m_bin_retained$XData[, c("lon", "lat")]
remove_genus_always_occur <- colnames(Y_bin)[colSums(Y_bin)<86]
Y_bin <- Y_bin[,remove_genus_always_occur]
preds_bin <- stats::predict(m_bin_retained,
                            XData          = m_bin_retained$XData,
                            predictEtaMean = TRUE,
                            expected       = TRUE)

n_samples_bin <- length(preds_bin)
for (j in 1:n_samples_bin) {
  preds_bin[[j]] <- preds_bin[[j]][,remove_genus_always_occur]          # [n_sites x n_species] probabilities
}
str(preds_bin)
n_species_bin <- ncol(preds_bin[[1]])
n_sites_bin   <- nrow(preds_bin[[1]])


# Stack list -> 3D array [n_sites x n_species x n_samples]
preds_arr_bin <- array(unlist(preds_bin),
                       dim = c(n_sites_bin, n_species_bin, n_samples_bin))

sim_list_bin <- vector("list", n_samples_bin)

colnames(Y_bin) == colnames(preds_bin[[1]])
for (j in 1:n_samples_bin) {
  prob_j <- preds_bin[[j]]          # [n_sites x n_species] probabilities
  sim_list_bin[[j]] <- as.vector(prob_j)
}

# Posterior mean probability as fitted value
mod_bin <- rowMeans(do.call(cbind, sim_list_bin))

str(do.call(cbind, sim_list_bin))
str(as.vector(Y_bin))
str(mod_bin)

dharma_bin <- createDHARMa(
  simulatedResponse       = +do.call(cbind, sim_list_bin)>0.5,
  observedResponse        = as.vector(Y_bin),
  fittedPredictedResponse = mod_bin,
  integerResponse         = T
)

pdf("figures/figures_manuscript/residuals_dharma_bin_second_best_waic.pdf",
    width = 10, height = 5)
plot(dharma_bin, main = "DHARMa residuals -- Occurrence (Probit):")
dev.off()

plot(dharma_bin, main = "DHARMa residuals -- Occurrence (Probit):")

cat("\n--- Uniformity ---\n");  print(testUniformity(dharma_bin))
cat("\n--- Dispersion ---\n");  print(testDispersion(dharma_bin))
cat("\n--- Outliers ---\n");    print(testOutliers(dharma_bin))

# Stack xy once per species to match the column-major order of as.vector(Y_bin).
# Occurrence data contains no NAs, so no filtering is needed.

dharma_bin <- createDHARMa(
  simulatedResponse       = do.call(cbind, sim_list_bin),
  observedResponse        = as.vector(Y_bin),
  fittedPredictedResponse = mod_bin,
  integerResponse         = F
)

xy_all_bin      <- xy_bin[rep(seq_len(n_sites_bin), times = n_species_bin), ]
coord_key_bin   <- paste(xy_all_bin[, "lon"], xy_all_bin[, "lat"], sep = "_")
coord_fac_bin   <- factor(coord_key_bin)
str(coord_fac_bin)
dharma_site_bin <- recalculateResiduals(dharma_bin, group = coord_fac_bin)
xy_unique_bin   <- xy_all_bin[match(levels(coord_fac_bin), coord_key_bin), ]

cat("\n--- Spatial autocorrelation ---\n")
print(testSpatialAutocorrelation(dharma_site_bin,
                                 x = xy_unique_bin[, "lon"],
                                 y = xy_unique_bin[, "lat"]))
pdf("figures/figures_manuscript/spatial_autocorr_dharma_bin_second_best_waic.pdf",
    width = 10, height = 5)
testSpatialAutocorrelation(dharma_site_bin,
                            x = xy_unique_bin[, "lon"],
                            y = xy_unique_bin[, "lat"], plot = T)
dev.off()
```
